title: SussyCraftables
description: A plugin that adds crafting recipes for suspicious sand and gravel
body:
**\* This plugin requires [NBT-API](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nbtapi) to work** A plugin that lets you craft suspicious sand and gavel with any item in it
Just put any item alongside with sand/gravel to create a suspicious variant of it containing the item you've put in
![Crafing example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6bd4c02bc0133906bb090656dfc9038bc12c322_0.webp) This plugin **preserves** NBT (durability, enchants, etc) of the item you've put in Inspired by [Suspicious Craftables](https://modrinth.com/plugin/suspicious-craftables) by [Rokuro17](https://modrinth.com/user/Rokuro17) which seems to be no longer maintained
